trail.text: Payment latency and memory are spiking — I'll trace the blast radius to find the source.
Payment shows resource exhaustion while its callers show only latency — now I'll check the remaining services for other culprits.
Most other services look healthy — I'll confirm the failure timeline to separate cause from victims.
Timeline confirms payment failed first and cascaded outward — now I'll submit the final ranking.

causes.reasoning: Payment memory explodes 8.4MB to 243MB mean (max 314MB) with failures 0.4 to 13620 and CPU surge, earliest onset at 5s, followed by p99 latency 5ms to 4.5s at 9s; resource exhaustion with no downstream dependency anomaly indicates origin.
Orders shows latency-only failure (p95 46ms to 3.7s, p99 to 4.58s matching payment) with no CPU/memory change and onset at 15s, 6s after payment, indicating victim caller blocked on payment.
Front-end tail latency p99 98ms to 2.85s onset at 20s with no resource change, propagating after orders/payment, indicating downstream user-facing victim.
Node shows modest disk-write and network uptick (21k to 77k bytes) likely host-level collateral of payment container churn, not causal as no latency or major resource exhaustion.
Exporter shows score 100 but absolute change 0 to 0.002s with no other metric deviation, indicating monitoring artifact/noise rather than causal failure.
